scope: Authenticated four-reference common-five source/input execution-accounting audit; no strategy candidate, no budget reset, no private source publication.

shared_input_basis.harness_behavior: The native harness loads the frozen quant market once, records qfq input as a known limitation, and writes the same adjusted OHLCV/economic-unit frames into each private reference adapter without rewriting prices.
shared_input_basis.conclusion: Corporate-action/actual-share accounting is a shared comparison-basis limitation, not an isolated defect in one reference. No corrected return is manufactured from this static finding.

trae_historical_stamp.decision: Per the preregistered fee scope, do not expand this into a reference-by-reference fee grid.

static_conclusions: The historical stamp-rate mismatch is real but the fixed Trae diagnostic measures only a 0.3362% terminal-wealth effect; it is not a plausible explanation for the order-of-magnitude strategy gap.

Other commission/slippage/minimum/transfer differences are disclosed native execution assumptions, not automatically bugs. Replacing all private costs with quant costs without a prospective contract would redefine the benchmarks rather than repair one proven defect.

All four authenticated native replays share the qfq adjusted-economic-unit adapter. The current harness explicitly does not certify an actual-share corporate-action/tax ledger, so corporate-action normalization cannot be claimed complete for any side of the comparison.

No additional economic replay is justified by this static audit. Further correctness work should be event-driven: inspect risk/protection state semantics and run a fixed comparator only if a specific issue binds an authenticated ledger.

attempt_log.chatgpt_native_replay_in_this_audit: Attempted exact native replay from authenticated source/input; stopped after 300 seconds with only START_NATIVE_REPLAY/IMPORT_FINISHED and no economic result. This incomplete run is not used as evidence and is not a reason to rerun because the preregistered fee scope already says to stop after the Trae correction proved economically small.
